summary: Copies two fixed-size lookup tables from ROM into a single runtime buffer at unk_8B1924 using an interleaved 32-byte-block pattern. First pass sources 16*15 blocks of 32 bytes from unk_5B6F0C using offsets (j - i) with j in {0..896 step 64} and i in {0..30 step 2}; second pass sources 16*17 blocks of 32 bytes from unk_5B730C using offsets (m - k) with m in {0..1024 step 64} and k in {0..30 step 2}.. A no-op stub is called first. Semantic purpose (e.g. audio/DSP coefficient de-interleave or transpose) is not proven by the packet.

local_names.v3: destination pointer for table-A block copy
local_names.v7: destination pointer for table-B block copy
local_names.result: table-B source offset (m - k), incidentally returned

Outer loop i from 0 to 30 step 2 (16 iterations) selects an interleave row.
Inner loop j from 0 to 896 step 64 (15 iterations) selects a source block.
Table-A source offset v4 = j - i.
Copies 32 bytes from unk_5B6F0C + (j - i) into current destination v3 and advances v0 by 32.
Second outer loop k from 0 to 30 step 2 (16 iterations).
Second inner loop m from 0 to 1024 step 64 (17 iterations).
Copies 32 bytes from unk_5B730C + (m - k) into current destination v7 and advances v0 by 32.
Returns the last computed offset (m - k); value is incidental, not a meaningful status.
